queue_frames.description: Frames queued per connection before the oldest is dropped.

A send that takes longer ends the connection: close code 1008 `too_slow` when the close frame

post.summary:
Validates a behavior graph document without changing any state. A `name` that is absolute or
contains `..` is refused with `422 validation_failed`. Inside a loaded scenario the
document sees the session's plugins and graphs; otherwise only the engine's own. The
diagnostics are the result: an invalid document answers 200 with `valid: false`.

get.summary:
The behavior catalog: node types, conditions, actions and behavior graphs, each with its schema,
version and provenance. With a scenario it includes the session's plugins and graphs; without
one, the engine's own entries.

The registered components, optionally of one kind. With a scenario the list includes the
plugins' components and the scenario's behavior graphs; without one, the engine's own.

Loads a scenario, replacing the session. Every failure leaves the server `idle`: the previous
session is gone (D-a).

get.description:
Refused before the upgrade, in this order: an `Origin` that is not allowed (`403
origin_not_allowed`; no `Origin` is allowed), an `encoding` other than `json` (`400
unsupported_encoding`), a request that is not a WebSocket upgrade (`400 bad_request`), and more
open stream connections than `[server.stream] max_connections` (`503 too_many_connections`).

parameters.description:

`400 unsupported_encoding`.
